package httptransport

import "net/http"

func (server *Server) executionProjection(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	result, err := server.Runtime.ExecutionProjection(request.Context(), request.URL.Query().Get("student_id"), request.PathValue("instanceID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeUsecaseError(writer, 0, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}
